## About the symposium

Thank you for your interest in the 15^th^ International Symposium of The International Fossil Coral and Reef Society! The symposium is due to take place in 2027 in Toulouse, France. Planning is currently underway and we will share the details as soon as possible. We plan to share the first circular with you in 2026.
